weights: iid uniform integers1..9, sorted networkx edge iterator, as frozen P43 helper
source: N=k photons, one per fixed shared S0 from charged strict best-swap frontend
incumbent: best of S0, pure greedy q0, y0 decoder and all vacuum decoder settings, all charged and common
decoder_seeds: ceil(k/2) largest standardized fluctuation entries, shared fixed vertex priority breaks ties
decoder_completion: add vertex minimizing exact cut marginal minus lambda*mean_edge_weight*field, until balanced
score_unit_accounting: EVERY partial candidate marginal inspected plus ONE final feasible cut;42+1 at m16,65+1 at m20
standardization: sqrt(max(diag(C_B),1e-12)), common to all raw fields
phase_multinomial: draw z uniform4roots, N categorical particles with probabilities eta*abs(V*z)^2/N and loss category1-eta
iid_variance: independent zero mean Gaussians with matching B marginal variances
species4: fixed graph photon permutation, groups4+4 or4+4+2
paired_ablation: permute standardized B observation values each draw; second decoder cost charged, zero additional photons; never used to select primary B setting
selection: each model independently maximizes pooled raw mean gain against Cref, allzero=identity, lexicographic tie
seed_derivation: P43 helper SHA256 first4 bytes little-endian on slash-joined components
resource_failure: retain partial data, RESOURCE_INCONCLUSIVE, no dropped graphs or silent reseeding
novelty: OPEN, mean-field/twirl controls known, no novel-theorem claim
